title: Product Bundle Photos for Clearer Listings | AIVideosUGC
description: Show every item in your kit in one square bundle photo. Use it on Amazon, Shopify, gift pages, social ads and posts without another styled shoot.
h1: Product Bundle Photos That Show Every Shipped Piece
lead: Open a bundle scene, add one photo of the complete kit, and download a square image shoppers can count.
steps_h2: Make Kit and Bundle Listing Images in 3 Steps
steps_lead: Every piece in one photo, one arrangement, then a square file you can price in your editor.

steps.d: Upload one clear photo of the complete kit, including the box and any insert. Keep every shipped piece in frame so nothing is invented.
Name an arrangement that keeps each piece visible, on a clean or light backdrop if that matches the listing. A long description is optional.
Download the square image and compare each object with your written contents list. Add the current price in your editor before posting.

faq.q: What is a product bundle photo template?
faq.a: It is a ready-made set scene. Add one photo of the kit you ship and download a square image that shows those pieces together.

faq.q: Do I have to write a long description?
faq.a: No. Open this bundle template and upload the kit photo. Add one short line about the arrangement only if you want to.
Shops and gift brands that need a contents view for a listing, a bundle page or an ad, and agencies making that image for them.

faq.q: Can one photo show every item?
faq.a: Yes, when each piece is visible and the full set fits in the frame. The image should not add a piece that was not in the photo.

faq.q: Can I put the price on the photo?
faq.a: Add the current price, offer or contents line in your editor after download. The generator does not write that live text for you.

faq.q: Can the bundle sit on a white background?
faq.a: Yes. Choose a clean scene when a white or light backdrop matches the listing.

faq.q: Do I need props or a second shoot?
faq.a: No. The scene is generated from the kit photo you upload. You are not booking a styled shoot for each gift set.

faq.q: What does a bundle photo cost?
faq.a: Each product photo costs 24 credits. The charge is shown before the job starts, and a failed job returns those credits.

faq.q: Can I use the image in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark and can run in your own ads, pages and posts. You remain responsible for the contents and any claims.
Arrange the full kit so each piece is visible, then compare the download with your written contents list before you post it.

steps.sourceHint: Include the coffee bag, grinder, mug and every piece that ships with the kit.
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded coffee starter kit as the exact product set: preserve its plain kraft pouch, black hand grinder, speckled white mug and their colors. Show the complete kit together on a bright wood table with every item visible. Natural window light, square product photo, no text or logos.
